newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barley weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barley weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA barley export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales reductions of 28,600 MT resulted as increases for the United Kingdom (7,700 MT) and Ireland (3,700 MT) were offset by decreases for unknown destinations (40,000 MT) which were switched for delivery in the 1997/98 marketing year.

Sales of 50,000 MT for delivery in 1997/98 were all for unknown destinations. Exports of 13,000 MT improved from last week's low level. The destinations were the United Kingdom (7,700 MT), Ireland (3,700 MT), and Mexico (1,600 MT).
